# Indented Backtick Labels

Four-space-indented horizontal chart rows that begin with backticks are data,
not closing fences.

```mdf-bar-chart
key,value
    ```,2
After Backticks,1
```

Four-space-indented vertical chart rows that begin with backticks are data,
not closing fences.

```mdf-vertical-bar-chart
key,value
    ```,2
After Backticks,1
```

Four-space-indented tile chart rows that begin with backticks are data, not
closing fences.

```mdf-tile-chart
key,value
    ```,2
After Backticks,1
```
